desc: The Tokarev TSA-12 is an innovative 12GA semi-automatic shotgun built for versatility and fast handling. Featuring an 18.5" barrel, synthetic stock, optics-ready drilled and tapped receiver, fiber optic front sight, and 4+1 capacity, the TSA-12 stands apart with its unique stock-actuated charging system that manually cycles the bolt by pulling the buttstock or pistol grip rearward.
